citation: Setyawan et al., FaceLiVT: Face Recognition Using Linear Vision Transformer with Structural Reparameterization for Mobile Device
problem: Mobile/edge face recognition with ViT efficiency
method: Linear ViT with structural reparameterization and Multi-Head Linear Attention (MHLA)
dataset: Glint360K, LFW, CFP-FP, AgeDB-30, IJB-B, IJB-C
reported_results: Reported 8.6x faster than EdgeFace on target mobile hardware; competitive on LFW
limitations: Authors have not released public pretrained model weights (marked TODO in repo)
implementation_decision: Reviewed candidate; NOT implemented due to lack of public weights

citation: George et al., EdgeFace: Efficient Face Recognition Model for Edge Devices
problem: Compact edge face recognition under compute constraints
method: Hybrid CNN-Transformer with edge-tailored inductive bias (EdgeFace XS/S)
dataset: AdaFace/InsightFace training sets, LFW, AgeDB, CFP-FP
metrics: EER, FMR, FNMR, latency, model size
reported_results: High accuracy across edge benchmarks; 7.17 MB model size
relevance: Comparison and primary working recognition backbone
implementation_decision: IMPLEMENTED and verified (37.2 ms CPU latency)

citation: Yu et al., YOLO-FaceV2: A Scale and Occlusion Aware Face Detector
problem: Occlusion and scale variation in face detection
method: Reparameterized multi-scale CNN detector based on YOLO architecture
limitations: Complex YOLOv5 dependency chain; heavy on entry-level i3 CPU
implementation_decision: Reviewed; engineering fallback (MediaPipe BlazeFace at 3.5ms) selected

citation: Khan et al., Spatio-temporal deep learning for improved face presentation attack detection
reported_results: Low error rates on benchmark replay sets
limitations: No public code repository or weights released
implementation_decision: NOT IMPLEMENTED; no public code available

citation: Khan, Face presentation attack detection via content-adaptive spatial operators
method: CASO-PAD: MobileNetV3-Large with grouped content-adaptive involution
limitations: Training code exists on GitHub; no downloadable pretrained weights released

citation: Patel et al., Enhancing Classroom Attendance Systems with Face Recognition through CCTV using Deep Learning
problem: Automated classroom attendance monitoring via CCTV
method: ResNet-50 / VGG-16 with PCA feature extraction
reported_results: Demonstrated feasibility of multi-student logging from stationary camera
limitations: High compute requirements; no confidence review or spoofing defense
relevance: Contextual baseline for classroom face attendance

citation: Sun and Liu, Ensuring Privacy in Face Recognition: A Survey on Data Generation, Inference and Storage
problem: Privacy vulnerabilities across the face recognition lifecycle
method: Taxonomy of template protection, local inference, and de-identification
protocol: Threat modeling for template leakage & reconstruction
reported_results: Reconstruction attacks possible from raw templates; highlights local storage & consent
limitations: Emphasizes need for cryptographic protection and strict consent protocols
relevance: Grounding for SmartAttend privacy architecture (consent, local storage, pseudonymization)
